hook: Banks asked to *restructure* loans of drought-hit farmers
hook_b: Banks asked to *restructure* loans of drought-hit farmers
tldr: Deputy CM Bhatti Vikramarka urged banks at a special SLBC meeting to support farmers hit by drought in Kharif 2026.

beats.what: He asked banks to restructure and reschedule loans where applicable and give timely fresh credit.
beats.why: Drought conditions this Kharif season have hit farmers across the state.
beats.care: Farm families with crop loans can ask their bank about restructuring under drought relief.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: RBI, NABARD, SBI and the Centre's Department of Financial Services attended.

cards.q: Should drought-hit farmers get automatic loan restructuring?

qs: How will a farmer know if they qualify for restructuring?

facts.t: The review covered the quarter ended *September 2026*.

learn.t: SLBC = State Level Bankers' Committee, where banks and the govt coordinate lending.

watch: Whether banks announce how many farm loans they restructure.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana SLBC urges banks to support drought-hit farmers with fresh credit

fact: Drought-hit Telangana farmers could get *restructured loans and fresh credit*.
twist: It was a special drought meeting held alongside the bankers' 51st quarterly review.
